races.paceDynamic: Suspicious Mindz will lead from the gates with minimal early pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in a field lacking natural pace horses. The soft ground and 1m trip will create a steady, stamina-testing gallop rather than fierce early speed. With most runners adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, the race will develop into a sustained drive from the 3f marker. This honest pace strongly favours horses with proven stamina and finishing kick over pure speed merchants.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz gets an easy lead and stays the trip
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls fractions on testing ground while others struggle to reel him in late. His class edge (RPR 95) and tactical advantage prove decisive in stamina-sapping conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the honest pace sets up perfectly for hold-up horses with finishing speed
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows patient riders to produce strong late runs, with proven stayers coming through. Soft ground amplifies stamina demands, suiting horses who have shown ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Flawless Fusion or New Radical can press the leader and outstay rivals
scenarios.body: A prominent runner shadows Suspicious Mindz before challenging turning for home, using tactical position to strike. Their fresher condition or superior class tells in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If lightly-raced Borora Aura shows hidden ability or unknown improves dramatically
scenarios.body: A lesser-fancied runner with undisclosed homework or significant improvement catches the field napping. The maiden nature of the contest allows for unexpected performances from unexposed types.

races.paceDynamic: Dervo Annie is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset with no early pressure expected. Glamazon, Spirit Honour, Nephin Mountain and Elora Prince will track in the prominent positions but are unlikely to challenge for the lead early. The large hold-up contingent including Personified, The Love Machine, Elly Bay and Balance Of Trade will be positioned off the pace hoping for a strong finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the uncontested leader and kick when Dervo Annie inevitably fades, as hold-up horses face a difficult task given the likely pedestrian early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses position perfectly behind the uncontested leader
scenarios.body: Dervo Annie sets steady fractions allowing trackers to conserve energy before her trademark fade sets in. Glamazon, Spirit Honour or Nephin Mountain can time their move perfectly from ideal stalking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow enough to allow closers time
scenarios.body: The pedestrian gallop creates a sprint finish where stamina becomes less important than pure speed. Personified or The Love Machine can overcome their positioning disadvantage with superior acceleration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Dervo Annie goes too slow and gets headed early
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace setters creates a messy tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial. Any horse finding clear running room can capitalise on the crawling pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unlikely Front End Success
scenarios.trigger: If Dervo Annie improves significantly from her recent showing
scenarios.body: The leader finds better form than her recent efforts suggest and maintains her gallop longer. Her light weight and trainer's recent success could combine for an upset.

watchPoints.text: Dervo Annie's early fractions will be crucial - if she goes too slowly she could get headed turning for home

The Love Machine's ability to overcome the likely lack of pace given his hold-up style but solid soft ground form
Multiple horses carrying claiming jockeys including Elly Bay and Elora Prince could struggle tactically in this field size
Weather conditions remain consistent yielding to soft which should suit most of the field's recent experience

races.paceDynamic: Romantic War will lead uncontested from the gates, setting a steady sustainable pace on the yielding to soft ground with no other confirmed front-runners in the field. The prominent runners Goldrush Kid, Suerte, Selective Power, Lahore Da King and Uncle Albert will sit just behind in second flight, but none are aggressive pace-pressers. This creates a moderate tempo that builds gradually, with the large contingent of hold-up horses including Mehman, Queen Aethelflaed, Bay Of Dreams and Summer Island getting plenty of time to wind up from the rear. The tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Romantic War leading unchallenged
scenarios.body: The large group of closers get ideal positioning and the testing ground aids their late surge over the tiring pace-setters. Mehman, Bay Of Dreams, Summer Island and Queen Aethelflaed have the profiles to benefit most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Goldrush Kid or Suerte apply more pace pressure than expected in mid-race
scenarios.body: The tempo lifts enough to stretch the field but not collapse the leaders, suiting horses with tactical speed. Selective Power and Lahore Da King can capitalize from their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Romantic War Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays very slow and Romantic War gets easy fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The leader's 12lb weight advantage tells and the closers leave their run too late on the testing ground. Romantic War holds on despite stamina concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage Romantic War early and create strong tempo
scenarios.body: The pace-setters stop quickly leaving a tactical muddle for any horse with reserve energy. This chaotic finish could suit an outsider getting a perfect trip.

watchPoints.text: Romantic War setting uncontested fractions could steal the race if pace stays very slow

races.paceDynamic: Baggot Street stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will likely dictate terms from the gates, with prominent runners Polar Bear, Girl Is On Fire, Art Of Unity, Steel Magnolia, Jordan Breeze and Platino Bianco likely to settle just behind. With 12 of the 18 runners preferring hold-up tactics, there's a significant shortage of early pace beyond Baggot Street, creating a tactical bottleneck. The soft ground will further emphasize stamina over pure speed in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners successfully track Baggot Street without applying excessive pressure early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace competition allows horses like Jordan Breeze, Art Of Unity or Steel Magnolia to travel smoothly before striking in the final furlong. The hold-up horses become trapped behind the wall of early positioned runners and cannot unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Baggot Street maintains an uncontested lead and finds the soft ground to his liking
scenarios.body: Despite his 120-day absence, the three-year-old gets an easy time in front and has enough left to resist the late challengers. The hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and creates a slow-run race
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up performers like Alnofoor or Happy Henry gets a dream passage through the field. The lack of early pace means stamina becomes less important and pure finishing speed prevails.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference problems in the straight
scenarios.body: A well-positioned outsider like Half Nutz or Steel Magnolia avoids the worst of the trouble and picks up the pieces. The favourites get caught up in the inevitable bumping and boring that occurs when 18 horses fight for room.

Cuban Grey, Amiata, Venetian, Mint Man, and Asdana all want prominent positions creating a wall of horses 2-3 lengths behind the leader. This congestion will cause traffic problems turning for home when the prominent brigade tries to quicken simultaneously. The lack of early pace pressure followed by late tactical complications strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the carnage and pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets stuck behind each other turning for home...
scenarios.body: The traffic jam allows Beauty Queen, Nezeeh, Sporting Hero or Aurora Nova to sweep around the outside with clear runs. Mc Loven's soft lead gets swamped by the late cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactical battle
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure a clear run at the right moment...
scenarios.body: Bay Of Supremacy or Amiata might time their move perfectly through a gap while others get trapped. Their class tells in a finish where positioning matters more than raw ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mc Loven stays clear
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes too late...
scenarios.body: The leader's soft fractions prove unbreakable on testing ground where stamina matters. The prominent pack's tactical battle costs them vital lengths they can't recover.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If Mc Loven goes too slow and gets swallowed up early...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse can win from any position. Form and class become irrelevant in a lottery finish decided by traffic luck.

races.paceDynamic: Radar Ahead is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely getting an easy lead with Bridgehead and Baila Conmigo pressing from prominent positions. With 11 hold-up horses in the field, the early pace will be comfortable as no one wants to commit early over this extended trip on testing ground. The lack of pace pressure means leaders can conserve energy for a sustained drive, while the large hold-up contingent will struggle for racing room in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Radar Ahead gets uncontested early fractions and stays galloping
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can dictate ideal splits and kick clear when the field comes under pressure, leaving the hold-up horses with too much ground to make up on this testing surface. Radar Ahead's recent proximity to these rivals gives him every chance to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Bridgehead or Baila Conmigo can track Radar Ahead and outkick him
scenarios.body: The Noel Meade runner returns from a long break but has winning form over course and distance, while Baila Conmigo brings solid recent form and will get first run on the leaders. Both avoid the traffic that will engulf those further back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse finds clear passage
scenarios.body: Justenzia has winning form on this surface and drops in class from recent runs, while Desert Friend showed renewed vigour with the tongue-tie last time and gets weight relief. The sheer number of hold-up horses makes traffic a major concern though.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If all the leaders stop and multiple hold-up horses charge home together
scenarios.body: The soft ground and extended trip could find out the front-runners' stamina, creating a blanket finish where any of the better-handicapped hold-up horses could prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.title: Prominent runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the early positioned horses avoids the traffic and kicks clear...
scenarios.body: Tim Toe or Good Deal uses superior class to overcome the crowding and win going away. Their prominent position becomes an advantage if they can navigate the inevitable interference.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Battling Siki stays clear
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader maintains his advantage as the field gets into trouble behind...
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader finds extra on soft ground while the pack struggles with traffic problems. Battling Siki's honest attitude and clear run proves decisive in a slowly-run finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is even slower than expected and becomes a sprint...
scenarios.body: The race turns into a mad dash where anything can happen and class tells. Higher-rated runners like Tim Toe overcome their poor position through superior acceleration.
